Multi-Omic STABL Cross-Validation Workflow

Source: R/multiomic_workflows.R, R/stabl_accessors.R
stabl_multiomic_cv.Rd

Builds deterministic fold splits over a named multi-omic input, fits stabl_multiomic_train_validate() on each training fold, and returns fold-wise selection diagnostics together with selected train/validation matrices for downstream inspection.

Usage

stabl_multiomic_cv(
  x_list,
  y,
  lambda_grid,
  v = 5L,
  groups = NULL,
  base_learner = "lasso",
  family = "gaussian",
  n_bootstraps = 100L,
  artificial_type = "random_permutation",
  hard_threshold = NULL,
  stratify_bootstrap = FALSE,
  bootstrap_strata = NULL,
  l1_ratio = NULL,
  random_state = NULL,
  early_fusion = FALSE,
  late_fusion = FALSE,
  late_fusion_training = "oof",
  late_fusion_nfolds = 5L,
  n_iter_lf = 10000L,
  cooperative_fusion = FALSE,
  rho = NULL,
  cooperation_selection = "cv",
  cooperation_selector = c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se"),
  cooperation_type_measure = "default",
  cooperation_nfolds = 5L,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'stabl_multiomic_cv'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x_list

Named list of omic tables (data.frame or numeric matrix), each with row names as sample IDs.

y

Named outcome vector.

lambda_grid

Either a shared lambda grid (data.frame or "auto") used for all omics, or a named list mapping each omic name to its own lambda grid. Prefer "auto" (each fold's grid is derived from its training data) or a grid computed from training data only: a grid computed on the full data leaks mild information into the cross-validated estimates.

v

Number of folds. Must be at least 2.

groups

Optional named grouping vector. When supplied, all samples in the same group are assigned to the same assessment fold.

base_learner

Passed to stabl_fit().

family

Character; glmnet response family ("gaussian", "binomial", "multinomial", or "cox"), or "ordinal" for base_learner = "ordinal". base_learner = "splsda" requires "binomial". Default: "gaussian".

n_bootstraps

Passed to stabl_fit().

artificial_type

Passed to stabl_fit().

hard_threshold

Passed to stabl_fit().

stratify_bootstrap

Passed to stabl_fit().

bootstrap_strata

Optional categorical bootstrap stratification design forwarded to stabl_fit() for each training fold.

l1_ratio

Passed to stabl_fit() when lambda_grid = "auto".

random_state

Optional integer seed used for deterministic fold assignment and forwarded to each per-fold stabl_fit() call.

early_fusion

Logical. Forwarded to each per-fold stabl_multiomic_train_validate() call.

late_fusion

Logical. Forwarded to each per-fold stabl_multiomic_train_validate() call.

late_fusion_training

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

late_fusion_nfolds

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

n_iter_lf

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

cooperative_fusion

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

rho

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

cooperation_selection

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

cooperation_selector

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

cooperation_type_measure

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

cooperation_nfolds

Forwarded to stabl_multiomic_train_validate().

...

Additional arguments forwarded to stabl_fit().

x

A numeric matrix or data.frame (samples \(\times\) features) with row names used as sample IDs.

Value

A list with class "stabl_multiomic_cv" containing:

folds

List of fold descriptors with fold, train_ids, and valid_ids.

fold_results

Named list of per-fold stabl_multiomic_fit results.

diagnostics

Data frame with one row per fold/omic and columns fold, omic, n_selected, threshold, and max_score.

fold_scheme

"group_disjoint" when groups is supplied (all samples of a group share one assessment fold — pass study labels here for study-disjoint CV), otherwise "sample_iid".

Details

Optional early-fusion, late-fusion, and cooperative-fusion branches are forwarded to each fold-specific stabl_multiomic_train_validate() call.

Methods (by generic)

  • print(stabl_multiomic_cv): Print a concise summary of a stabl_multiomic_cv object; invisibly returns x.

Note

Batch harmonization (e.g. ComBat) fitted on the full dataset before cross-validation leaks study-level information across folds and inflates performance estimates. Fit harmonization within training folds, or interpret all reported metrics as conditional on the harmonization step; group-disjoint folds do not repair leakage from pooled preprocessing.

Examples

set.seed(2L)
ids <- paste0("s", 1:12)
x_list <- list(
  rna = matrix(rnorm(12 * 4), 12, 4,
               dimnames = list(ids, paste0("g", 1:4))),
  protein = matrix(rnorm(12 * 3), 12, 3,
                   dimnames = list(ids, paste0("p", 1:3)))
)
y <- setNames(rnorm(12), ids)
cv <- stabl_multiomic_cv(
  x_list, y, lambda_grid = data.frame(lambda = 0.1), v = 2L,
  n_bootstraps = 2L, artificial_type = NULL, hard_threshold = 0.5,
  random_state = 2L
)
cv$diagnostics
#>          fold    omic n_selected threshold max_score
#> Fold1.1 Fold1     rna          1       0.5         1
#> Fold1.2 Fold1 protein          2       0.5         1
#> Fold2.1 Fold2     rna          1       0.5         1
#> Fold2.2 Fold2 protein          1       0.5         1
